about: One router and four specialists, on three free providers: the router on Groq, the history and maths tutors on Gemini, the language and science tutors on OpenRouter. The router chose the history tutor.
how: Every agent has its own key slot. The router answers with JSON; only the chosen specialist is started, on its own provider.
learns: One design can use several providers; each agent runs on the one that suits it, and the replay shows who answered.
watch: The colour and provider of each agent, and the statistics split by provider.
